title: rubus fruticosus f. nitidus
intro: Rubus fruticosus f. nitidus, commonly known as Black Raspberry, is a subspecies of the blackberry plant. It is a type of bramble that is native to North America and is known for its edible fruits, which are rich in antioxidants and have various health benefits. The health benefits of Rubus fruticosus f. nitidus include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high content of anthocyanins and other polyphenols. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties, which are attributed to bioactive constituents such as ellagic acid, salicylic acid, and anthocyanins.
